visualCharacteristics.purpose: Grid of downloadable document tiles, each a centred title with a DOWNLOAD button, inside one elevated white card
visualCharacteristics.summary: One white elevated card (1px #f7f7f7 border, soft shadow) holding image-less tiles, four per row with a shorter last row widening to fill (7 tiles = 4 + 3). Each tile: centred #535353 25px title paragraph (line breaks kept) above a red pill DOWNLOAD button (#ba0a29, white uppercase, letter-spaced). 1px red-to-purple vertical rules between tiles in a row; tiles stack with no rules on mobile.

contentPattern.structure: Cards (no images): one row per document with a single rich-text cell (UE field text): title paragraph(s), then a paragraph holding only the DOWNLOAD link to the PDF

usage: Disclosure / document download grid (Other disclosures page: USA Patriot Act Notice, BCP Disclosure, Form CRS, Reg BI, fee schedules).
reuseGuidance: Use for lists of downloadable documents or single-CTA tiles without images. Keep the title as a paragraph and put the link alone in its own paragraph so it renders as the button. Any number of tiles works; rows hold four.
